or [[Dasha Vestibule]] }} ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Find the harpy roosts in the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]] and eliminate them. You have [4...0] roosts remaining. * See [[Lieutenant Murunda]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 2,000 [[Experience]] * 250 [[Gold]] * [[Trade Contract]] ===Environmental changes=== * [[Korrub, Flame of Dreams]] will [[spawn]] in Wilderness of Bahdza after this quest is completed. * [[Screecher]] and [[Scratcher]] will no longer spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza (except before or during [[Population Control]]) after this quest is completed. == Walkthrough == This quest requires to eliminate 4 groups of Harpies. Each of them have level 28 Elders and level 2 Hatchings, which makes them a large group but actually weak. All nests are located directly south from Dzagonur Bastion's [[portal]]. Follow the quest marker to find each of them. Return to Lieutenant Murunda for your reward. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Harpy|Harpies]] *{{w}} 28 (30) [[Elder Skree Raider]] *{{r}} 2 (22) [[Skree Hatchling (ranger)|Skree Hatchling]] *{{r}} 28 (30) [[Elder Skree Tracker]] *{{mo}} 28 (30) [[Elder Skree Griffin]] *{{p}} 28 (30) [[Elder Skree Singer]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Lieutenant Murunda''' :''"My scouts have just returned from patrol and have located four skree harpy roosts. These beasts have been a thorn in our side for weeks and it's time we dealt with them."'' :''"I don't have the manpower to send a squad out to take care of them, but I do have the authority to hire mercenaries such as yourselves for the job. Are you feeling up to a little '''harpy''' killing?"'' {{offer dialog |accept = Sure, how hard could it be? |decline = What do I look like, the queen of harpies? |ask = Have you rooted out all of the '''harpy''' nests? }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''Lieutenant Murunda''' :''"Fantastic! That should keep those feathered creeps out of our hair for awhile. Here's your reward."'' == Notes == * If you keep the quest without claiming its rewards, the Skree Harpies [[spawn]]ed by it can be farmed for [[Bolt of Cloth]]s, [[Feather]]s, [[Skree Wing]]s and [[Tanned Hide Square]]s. * You cannot capture [[Visions of Regret]] until this quest is completed. ==Trivia== *"Queen of the harpies" (in the decline option) is a phrase lifted from the movie [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0061184/ Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?], subsequently spoofed by the Simpsons (among others), although the term can also mean a particularly naggy woman.
